scope: Publicly documented platform metadata and data-category schemas for X, Instagram, and Snapchat; no private account exports or unauthorized access

public_metadata_categories: public location attached to posts when enabled
X.api_scope: X states that its APIs provide programmatic access to public X data by default; non-public endpoints such as Direct Messages require additional authorization.
X.retention_note: X's current privacy policy describes different retention periods by category, including profile/usage information, cookies/device/location/log information, and ad interaction information.

public_metadata_categories: likes/comments and engagement signals where publicly visible
public follower/following relationship information where visible
public account category/professional information where displayed
public location information attached to content where enabled
platform_data_categories_documented_by_M: information from partners and third-party services
Instagram.note: Instagram is part of Meta's services. Exact fields and availability vary by feature, account settings, region, and current Meta policy/API access. This repository records category-level public documentation rather than private Instagram account data.

Snapchat.metadata_definition: Snap states that metadata associated with Snaps and Chats includes information such as date, time, sender, and receiver, and distinguishes metadata from message content.
public_metadata_categories: public content publication/view metadata where disclosed
location_categories: precise location when permission is enabled
Snapchat.retention_note: Snap states that most Snap/Chat metadata is deleted after 30 days, while information may be retained longer when needed and personal identifiers may be removed for analytics.

security_and_privacy_boundary: No precise location tracking of individuals
method: Category-level extraction from official public privacy, help, and API documentation. It does not represent a dump of platform backend telemetry or individual-user records.
